syncBusyWait: A sync is running; wait until it finishes.
workspaceNoRepoBody: ReadPaper reads Zotero libraries synced to GitHub by the zotero-github-sync plugin. Add a repository ({access}) to start reading, highlighting and commenting on papers.
workspaceResumeNote: The previous download was interrupted. Resuming only fetches the files not saved yet.
workspaceLazyNote: The library metadata is downloaded now; PDFs follow when each paper is opened.
workspaceLibraryUnreadableBody: The repository is on this device but no Zotero structure was found (collections.json and an items/ folder). Make sure it is an export of the Zotero GitHub Sync plugin, then pull the latest changes.
syncLfsMissing: git-lfs is not installed; large attachments stay as pointers
syncRecloneNotice: This local copy still holds every attachment. Fetching it again downloads only metadata; PDFs follow when each paper is opened.
syncRecloneBody: The local folder is deleted and fetched again without attachments. Annotations already sent to GitHub are safe; unsent ones would be lost, so this is refused while changes are pending.
workspaceTransferRepoNotFetched: Repository "{name}" has not been fetched to this device. Open it once and fetch its library, then try again.
workspaceTransferLibraryMissing: The library in "{name}" is not on this device yet. Open that repository once and fetch its library, then try again.
workspaceTransferNoOthers: There is no other repository yet. Add one first in the Repositories settings.
workspaceTransferMoveNote: Removed from this repository once the copy is complete at the destination.
workspaceTransferCopyNote: This one stays; the destination gets a copy.
workspaceStatsNotFetched: not fetched to this device yet
syncStatusAhead: {count, plural, =1{1 commit} other{{count} commits}} not pushed
workspaceErrNoZoteroExport: No Zotero export found in this repository. Expected structure: zotero/<library>/collections.json
workspaceErrNoRemoteUrl: This profile has no remote URL yet.
workspaceErrUnsentBeforeReclone: There are changes not yet sent to GitHub. Send them first, then fetch again.
workspaceErrDeleteOldCopy: Could not delete the old copy: {error}
workspaceErrAnnotationNoLibrary: Annotation not saved: no library is open in the app.
workspaceErrAnnotationUnchanged: Annotation not saved: the item file did not change.
workspaceErrAnnotationDeleteNoLibrary: Annotation not deleted: no library is open.
workspaceErrPictureNoRepo: Image not saved: no repository is open.
workspaceErrNoLibraryForFile: No library is open to hold this file.
workspaceErrAddToLibrary: Could not add to the library: {error}
workspaceErrNoLibraryForFolder: No library is open to hold this folder.
workspaceErrSameRepo: The destination is the same repository.
workspaceErrMissingAttachments: {count} attachments are not on this device yet — not downloaded, or still Git LFS pointers. Open the paper once so its PDF is downloaded (on desktop: LFS pull), then try again. Nothing was moved: without its PDF the paper would arrive empty.
workspaceErrTargetCollectionGone: The destination collection no longer exists.
workspaceErrDeleteClone: Could not delete the local clone: {error}
syncFileAlreadyLocal: The file is already on this device
syncFileNotInRepo: The file is not in this repository.
syncTargetNotEmpty: The destination folder already has files. Delete them or choose another location.
syncRepoReadyLazy: Repository ready. Attachments download when each paper is opened.
syncInterruptedNotAborted: The previous sync stopped in the middle of a {operation} and could not be undone automatically. Its state was backed up at {backup}.
syncInterruptedRecovered: The sync that stopped midway was recovered (backup: {backup})
syncConflict: Changes here and on GitHub conflict and cannot be merged automatically. Nothing is lost: local changes stay in their commit{detail}.
syncRebasedOnGitHub: Local changes were applied on top of the GitHub version
syncErrSshRejected: SSH refused: GitHub did not accept the key. Check the key path in the profile.
syncErrHttpsAuth: HTTPS authentication failed: the token is empty or invalid.
syncErrRepoNotFound: Repository not found, or no access to it.
syncErrMergeConflict: There is a conflict merging changes. Resolve it in the local repository.
syncErrTreeTooLarge: The repository file list is too large for the GitHub API to read at once.
syncErrBlobTooLarge: The file is {size} MB, above the 100 MB limit the GitHub API accepts for one file. Send it with regular git on a computer, or keep the attachment outside the repository.
syncErrConnectionLost: The connection to GitHub dropped and did not recover after {attempts} attempts. The download can resume where it stopped.
syncErrTokenRejected: GitHub rejected the token. Check the token in the repository profile.
syncErrQuota: The GitHub request quota is used up. Try again once it recovers (about an hour), or use a token with a larger quota.
syncErrSlowDown: GitHub asked to slow down because too many files were sent in a row. Wait a few minutes, then send again.
syncErrForbidden: Access denied. The token needs "Contents: read and write" permission for this repository.
syncErrNotFound: Repository or file not found. For a private repository, the token must have access to it.
syncErrBranchMoved: The branch on GitHub has changed. Pull changes first, then send again.
syncErrRejectedNoReason: GitHub rejected this change (422) without giving a reason.
syncErrTokenMissing: No GitHub token has been entered.
syncErrNotGitHubUrl: The repository URL is not recognised as a GitHub repository.
syncErrAndroidNeedsToken: On Android, sync uses a GitHub token. Enter the token in the repository profile.
syncMirrorReady: Mirror ready: {files} metadata files, {attachments} attachments waiting to download when opened
syncPartialSaved: {error} {count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}} are already saved — press "Resume" to continue.
syncPullUpdated: Pull done: {count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}} updated
syncLfsUnsupportedAndroid: Git LFS files are not supported by Android sync yet.
syncAttachmentsSkippedOnly: {count} attachments skipped; nothing else to send
syncReadyToSend: {count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}} ready to send
syncReadyToSendSkipped: {count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}} ready to send; {skipped} attachments skipped (send them with git on a computer)
syncErrRemoteNewer: GitHub already has newer commits. Pull changes first, then send again.
syncErrQueueOnlyAttachments: The queue only holds attachments; nothing can be sent this way.
syncAllPdfsPresent: All PDFs are already on this device
syncAllPdfsPresentLfs: All PDFs are present; {count} LFS attachments must be fetched from a computer
syncErrNotMirrored: The repository has not been mirrored on this device.
syncRejectedSummary: {head}; {count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}} were rejected by GitHub and are still waiting: {names}{more}. {reason}
syncErrCorruptDownload: A file was corrupted while downloading: {name}. Run it again to re-download the failed part.
syncErrTokenMissingProfile: No GitHub token has been entered in the repository profile.
syncInstallGitWindows: Git for Windows was not found. Install it from git-scm.com, or in PowerShell: winget install --id Git.Git -e — then press Try again.
syncInstallGitMac: git was not found. Run in Terminal: xcode-select --install.
syncInstallGitLinux: git was not found. Install git and git-lfs — CachyOS/Arch: sudo pacman -S git git-lfs; Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install git git-lfs.
syncErrDecisionUnsupported: Rejected files can only be handled here for repositories synced through the GitHub API (Android). With git, take the file out of the commit (git rm --cached) and add it to .gitignore, or store it with Git LFS.
syncFilesExcluded: {count} files excluded: they stay on this device and are not sent to GitHub.
syncFilesIncluded: {count} files will be sent again with the next Send.
syncFilesRetry: {count} files will be tried again with the next Send.
syncFilesRemoved: {count} files deleted from this device and taken out of the send queue.
syncRemoveFilesBody: The files are deleted from this device and taken out of the send queue. This cannot be undone.
syncRemoveFilesOnRemote: {count} of them have an older version on GitHub; that version is deleted on GitHub too with the next Send.
syncRejectedIntro: GitHub rejected the files below — usually because they are over 100 MB. Everything else was sent. For each file choose: exclude (keep it on this device, never send it), delete it from the device, or try sending it again.
syncExcludedIntro: Kept on this device, but never sent to GitHub and not counted as a change.
